tomb_path.description: Path to the encrypted tomb storage file.

tomb_key_path.description: Path to the key file used to open the tomb.

tomb_size.description: Initial size of the tomb in megabytes (MiB) for 'dig' or 'resize'.

luks_cipher.description: LUKS encryption cipher specification. Supported: aes-xts-plain64, aes-cbc-essiv:sha256, serpent-xts-plain64.

filesystem_type.description: Filesystem type for the tomb. Supported: ext3, ext4, btrfs, btrfsmixedmode, ext3maxinodes, ext4maxinodes.

mount_options.description: Mount options for the tomb volume.

use_gpg_key.description: Enable GPG asymmetric encryption for the tomb key.

gpg_recipients.description: List of GPG key IDs for key encryption. If empty and use_gpg_key is true, falls back to symmetric password.

kdf_iter_time.description: KDF iteration time multiplier (millions) for dictionary attack protection.

kdf_type.description: KDF algorithm type: pbkdf2 or argon2.

kdf_mem.description: RAM size (2^k KB) for argon2 KDF. Default 18 is 250 MiB.

privilege_escalation_tool.description: Tool for privilege escalation: sudo, pkexec, doas, sup, sud.

sphinx_host.description: Host domain for SPHINX PAKE feature.

force.description: Force operations, overriding swap checks and other warnings.

bind_hooks.description: List of bind hooks to mount paths from tomb to home directory on open. Items contain tomb_path and home_path relative strings.
